title: ImageRequest
description: Input to modules/graphic-generation: an LLM-generated caption grounded in a temporal-KG subgraph, requesting a Flux Schnell image (or an incremental edit to an existing editable canvas region).

caption.description: LLM-generated caption to condition the image generation on.

subgraph_ref.description: Reference to the TemporalKG subgraph this caption was derived from, for traceability/re-generation.

node_ids.description: Node ids from temporal-kg.schema.json that grounded this caption.

edit_target.description: If set, this request edits an existing canvas region instead of generating a full new image (supports the editable/incremental graphic-recording goal).

style_refs.description: Optional pointers to a reusable image library, for reproducible visual style across sessions.
